name: A stored payer-name alias auto-matches a re-uploaded row
title: SC-07-02-05 A stored payer-name alias auto-matches a re-uploaded row
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the manager adds a payer-name alias for unit "A Blok D:14"
When the same statement is uploaded again
Then the row is matched to unit "A Blok D:14" automatically
